zh.title: 待审批请求恢复了，通知配置也跟着回来了吗？
zh.summary: 对比两家厂商的文档合同与七组内部局部检查，区分请求重发、响应关联和通知配置；它们仍不能代替送达与当前审批权限的实测。

en.title: The Review Request Returned. Did Its Notification Settings Return Too?
en.summary: Two vendor contracts and seven internal local checks separate request restoration, response correlation and notification configuration, leaving actual delivery and current reviewer authority untested.
